title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
陈轩的回答似乎令柳清霜很满意，饶是她向来冷淡的性格都微微颔首。可其他人就彻底绷不住了。“卧槽这狗日的真不要脸，大师姐岂是这个废物能配得上的？”“听闻楚金朗师兄一直对大师姐倾慕不已，他要是知道大师姐和陈轩这个废柴结了道侣……”“大师姐这是练功走火入魔了吧？”……大师姐柳清霜何许人也？天玄宗宗主千金，极品冰灵根修士，年方二十便已迈入通玄境界，惊才艳艳之人。更是有着一张美得不可方物的脸蛋，一直以来都是天玄宗乃至整个大楚王朝的梦中仙子。可今日，竟主动提出要和陈轩这个废物结为道侣！天鹅配天鹅，这是天造地设的良缘。可若是一只癞蛤蟆爬到了天鹅身上，那就会恶心无数青年了。感受着诸多火辣辣，不加掩饰的恶意眼神，陈轩全都置若罔闻，不甚在意。“师姐，既已是道侣，这杯酸梅汤还请收下。”“虽不是什么珍馐之物，但采自血乌梅，有清神之效，且冰凉可口，拿来解暑再好不过。”陈轩微笑着递出手中酸梅汤。“嗯。”柳清霜狭长美眸眨了眨，纤手一拂便将其收起。瞬间，陈轩耳边声音作响，面前更是有着字幕浮现。【柳清霜已收下宿主送出的“酸梅汤”】【获得：冰鲜酸梅汤x10】果然可以！试水成功，陈轩嘴角缓缓勾起。如此看来只要自己给柳清霜送出礼物，都会获得十倍返还的奖励。旋即系统声音再次作响。【宿主与道侣“柳清霜”已解锁亲密度模块。】【介绍：宿主对于道侣的每一份礼物送出，或者做出任何对道侣有益的举动，都会增加亲密度，亲密度越高，绑定的返还奖励越丰富。】【目前已激活：十倍躺平返还。】【介绍：只要宿主继续躺平，道侣从今以后任何修炼成果都会以十倍返还给宿主。】解锁了亲密度么，也就是说和柳清霜关系越好，可以得到的奖励就越多。所以自己接下来只需继续躺平，然后与柳清霜上升关系就好。狠狠地上！

回到眼前，陈轩看柳清霜真是愈发顺眼了。而那些师兄弟们看自己，则是愈发想弄死自己。旁边杜青峰亦是深叹一声，老脸写尽了惆怅：“清霜，婚姻大事不是儿戏，掌门师兄可知晓此事？”柳清霜面若冰霜道：“我会告诉他的。”“何苦呢，唉。”别人或许不知道，杜青峰是明白柳清霜此举含义的。身为天之娇女，整个大楚王朝不少皇子世子，宗门少爷都踏破了天玄宗门槛，想要与柳清霜结亲。尤其是近年来她修为堪称妖孽般精进，样貌身材这地长开后更是倾国倾城的存在，追求者数不胜数。譬如皇子楚金朗，为追求她甚至都入了天玄宗，平日里亦是爱慕有加，追求狂热。这份热情就算是掌门师兄也啧啧惊叹，都动了要许配给他的心思。但柳清霜如同万年坚冰一般毫不动容，没人能进得了她的心。许是被叨扰的烦了，就主动与陈轩这废柴结成道侣，堵住所有人的嘴。外面那些天才少爷忙活多年，到头来还是被陈轩给捡了漏。多少有些极端了。“情霜啊，倘若你……”“杜长老不必多言，我意已决，一诺千金。”柳清霜清冷的声音截断了他的劝诫。“陈轩，就是我的道侣。”“……罢了罢了。”杜青峰见其执拗也便不好再说些什么。转身走向那些停下修炼的弟子。“都看够了吧，哪来那么多时间让你们看热闹！”“莫非你们也想效仿某个废物无所事事？！练！”他怒然一声直接喝住了众多弟子，赶紧继续热火朝天修炼起来。陈轩慵懒地打了个哈欠，重新靠在树荫下，惬意地看着他们在挥洒汗水。练吧，别跟哥比，哥有挂。“陈轩。”此时柳清霜瞥来眼神，见其一派懒散模样当即微微蹙眉。“娘子。”陈轩笑说。“不必改口，叫我柳清霜。”“好的，娘子。”唰~
content_en:
Chen Xuan's answer seemed to satisfy Liu Qingshuang, who nodded slightly despite her always cold personality.But others couldn't hold it any longer."Damn this bitch, you are so shameless. How can Senior Sister be worthy of this good-for-nothing?" "I heard that Senior Brother Chu Jinlang has always been in love with Senior Sister. If he knew that Senior Sister and this good-for-nothing Chen Xuan had become a Taoist couple..." "Is Senior Sister going crazy with her practice?"...Who is Senior Sister Liu Qingshuang?The daughter of Tianxuan Sect's sect leader, a top-notch ice spirit root monk, who has entered the realm of Tongxuan at the age of twenty, is an amazingly talented person.She also has an incredibly beautiful face and has always been the dream fairy of Tianxuan Sect and even the entire Chu Dynasty.But today, he actually offered to become a Taoist couple with Chen Xuan, a loser!A swan meets a swan, a match made in heaven.But if a toad climbed onto the swan, it would disgust countless young people.Feeling the many hot and unabashed malicious looks, Chen Xuan turned a deaf ear to them all and didn't care much."Senior sister, since you are a Taoist monk, please accept this cup of sour plum soup." "Although it is not a delicacy, it is taken from the blood black plum, which has a refreshing effect and is cold and delicious. It is perfect for relieving the heat." Chen Xuan smiled and handed over the sour plum soup in his hand."Yeah." Liu Qingshuang blinked her narrow beautiful eyes and put it away with a flick of her delicate hand.Instantly, a voice rang in Chen Xuan's ears, and subtitles appeared in front of him.[Liu Qingshuang has accepted the "Sour Plum Soup" sent by the host] [Obtained: Chilled Sour Plum Soup x10] It sure works!After successfully testing the waters, the corners of Chen Xuan's mouth slowly raised.It seems that as long as you give a gift to Liu Qingshuang, you will get ten times the reward.Immediately the system sound sounded again.[The host and Taoist companion "Liu Qingshuang" have unlocked the intimacy module.】[Introduction: Every gift the host gives to the Taoist couple, or makes any action that is beneficial to the Taoist couple, will increase the intimacy. The higher the intimacy, the richer the bound return rewards.】【Currently activated: Ten times the amount will be returned when lying flat.】【Introduction: As long as the host continues to lie down, any cultivation achievements of the Taoist monk from now on will be returned to the host tenfold.】Have the intimacy been unlocked? In other words, the better the relationship with Liu Qingshuang, the more rewards you can get.So all he had to do next was to continue to lie down and improve his relationship with Liu Qingshuang.On the ground hard!

Back in front of him, Chen Xuan found Liu Qingshuang more and more pleasing to his eyes.When those fellow apprentices looked at themselves, they wanted to kill themselves more and more.Du Qingfeng next to him also sighed deeply, his old face full of melancholy: "Qingshuang, marriage is not a trivial matter. Does the head brother know about this?" Liu Qingshuang said with a frosty face: "I will tell him." "Why bother, alas." Others may not know, but Du Qingfeng understands the meaning of Liu Qingshuang's move.As the beloved daughter of heaven, many princes, sons and young masters of the entire Chu Dynasty have crossed the threshold of Tianxuan Sect and wanted to marry Liu Qingshuang.Especially in recent years, her cultivation has been as advanced as that of a demon, and her appearance and figure have become even more impressive, with countless suitors.For example, the prince Chu Jinlang even joined the Tianxuan Sect in order to pursue her. He also loved her very much and pursued her passionately.Even the senior brother in charge was amazed by this enthusiasm, and even thought of marrying him.But Liu Qingshuang was as unmoved as ten thousand years of ice, no one could get into her heart.Xu was annoyed by the nagging, so he took the initiative to form a Taoist couple with Chen Xuan, a good-for-nothing, and silenced everyone.Those talented young masters outside have been busy for many years, but in the end they were picked up by Chen Xuan.It's somewhat extreme."Qingshuang, if you..." "Elder Du, there is no need to say more, I have made up my mind, and I promise you a thousand pieces of gold." Liu Qingshuang's cold voice cut off his admonishment."Chen Xuan is my Taoist companion." "...That's all." Seeing his stubbornness, Du Qingfeng couldn't say anything else.He turned around and walked towards the disciples who had stopped practicing."You've seen enough, how can I have so much time for you to watch the fun!" "Do you also want to imitate some waste and do nothing?! Practice!" He shouted angrily and stopped many disciples, and quickly continued to practice enthusiastically.Chen Xuan yawned lazily, leaned against the shade of the tree again, and watched them sweating comfortably.Just practice, don't compete with me, I'm sorry."Chen Xuan." At this time, Liu Qingshuang glanced at him and frowned slightly when she saw his lazy look."Madam." Chen Xuan said with a smile."No need to change your words, call me Liu Qingshuang." "Okay, madam." Wow~
